name: UrBackup
description: Auto client-push by default; ECDSA-signed updater vs bundled pinned pubkey (over plain HTTP — signature carries integrity).
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed UrBackup server client-update path, update files are checked with verifyFile using an ECDSA public-key file and a matching .sig2 sidecar; an administrator-configured public-key path can override the default. Deployment-wide transport and default-push behavior remain outside this evidence.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; this source read does not establish the client-push default, transport authentication, or release-specific key distribution.

original_evidence.text: | **UrBackup** (github.com/uroni/urbackup_backend, client+server) | **Y** | **Y** — enabled by default (`autoupdate_clients` setting defaults to `"true"`); server periodically fetches new client-agent builds and pushes them to connected clients with no admin interaction required | Y — server downloads `UrBackupUpdate.exe` / `UrBackupUpdateLinux.sh`, pushes to client over its protocol; client verifies then **executes it** as an installer/update binary | **plain HTTP** (`http://update.urbackup.org/2.5.x/`), no TLS at all for the download; integrity relies entirely on the offline signature, not transport security | Y — a detached signature file (`.sig2`, plus legacy `.sig`) is fetched alongside the payload and verified before install | **signature** — ECDSA (EC2N binary-field curve) + SHA-256 via Crypto++ (`CryptoPP::ECDSA<CryptoPP::EC2N, CryptoPP::SHA256>`), plus a separate SHA-512 "already-applied" hash check to prevent replay/downgrade of a previously-used update | verifying key is a **bundled/pinned public-key file shipped with the client install**, `urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` (found at `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` and `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver_installer_win/data_common/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub`; loaded client-side from `share/urbackup/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` on macOS or `UPDATE_SIGNATURE_PREFIX "urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub"` elsewhere) — not fetched over the network at update time | Update fetch (HTTP, no TLS): `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_update.cpp:32` (URL), `:99-140` (downloads `.sig2`/`.sig` + payload). Auto-trigger: `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_cleanup.cpp:253,332` (`upd.update_client()` called from periodic cleanup); default-on setting: `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_settings.cpp:319` (`autoupdate_clients` default `"true"`). Client-side verification: `urbackup_backend/urbackupclient/ClientService.cpp:620-644` (`crypto_fak->verifyFile(pubkey, ...)` then `checkHash(getSha512Hash(...))` then move into place as `.exe`/`.sh` and execute). Verification implementation: `urbackup_backend/cryptoplugin/CryptoFactory.cpp:173-196` (`CryptoFactory::verifyFile`, real ECDSA-SHA256 `SignatureVerificationFilter` via Crypto++, not a bare hash compare) |

fields.label: auto
fields.value: **Y** — enabled by default (`autoupdate_clients` setting defaults to `"true"`); server periodically fetches new client-agent builds and pushes them to connected clients with no admin interaction required

fields.label: downloads_and_executes
fields.value: Y — server downloads `UrBackupUpdate.exe` / `UrBackupUpdateLinux.sh`, pushes to client over its protocol; client verifies then **executes it** as an installer/update binary

fields.label: transport
fields.value: **plain HTTP** (`http://update.urbackup.org/2.5.x/`), no TLS at all for the download; integrity relies entirely on the offline signature, not transport security

fields.label: manifest_signed
fields.value: Y — a detached signature file (`.sig2`, plus legacy `.sig`) is fetched alongside the payload and verified before install

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **signature** — ECDSA (EC2N binary-field curve) + SHA-256 via Crypto++ (`CryptoPP::ECDSA<CryptoPP::EC2N, CryptoPP::SHA256>`), plus a separate SHA-512 "already-applied" hash check to prevent replay/downgrade of a previously-used update

fields.label: verifying_key_source
fields.value: verifying key is a **bundled/pinned public-key file shipped with the client install**, `urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` (found at `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` and `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver_installer_win/data_common/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub`; loaded client-side from `share/urbackup/urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub` on macOS or `UPDATE_SIGNATURE_PREFIX "urbackup_ecdsa409k1.pub"` elsewhere) — not fetched over the network at update time

fields.label: evidence (file:line)
fields.value: Update fetch (HTTP, no TLS): `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_update.cpp:32` (URL), `:99-140` (downloads `.sig2`/`.sig` + payload). Auto-trigger: `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_cleanup.cpp:253,332` (`upd.update_client()` called from periodic cleanup); default-on setting: `urbackup_backend/urbackupserver/server_settings.cpp:319` (`autoupdate_clients` default `"true"`). Client-side verification: `urbackup_backend/urbackupclient/ClientService.cpp:620-644` (`crypto_fak->verifyFile(pubkey, ...)` then `checkHash(getSha512Hash(...))` then move into place as `.exe`/`.sh` and execute). Verification implementation: `urbackup_backend/cryptoplugin/CryptoFactory.cpp:173-196` (`CryptoFactory::verifyFile`, real ECDSA-SHA256 `SignatureVerificationFilter` via Crypto++, not a bare hash compare)
